verdict: TIER-2 WORKS WITH HONEST ABSTENTION. For membership genes (mostly signaling), the SIGNOR directed graph gives an upstream→downstream tier that is RIGHT for feed-forward genes (Spearman +0.55; clean cascades apoptosis/Wnt 0.85–0.94) and MEANINGLESS for feedback-loop genes (-0.16) — but the SCC flag KNOWS which is which. Whole-cell: only 47% of membership genes get a trustworthy tier, 3% sit in feedback modules (no linear level — the honest answer is a module, not a rank), 50% have no directed context at all. Unlike metabolism (a clean pipeline), signaling is a control system with loops — so 'level' is only partially definable, and the software says so instead of faking it.
note: tier-2 pathway level for membership genes via SIGNOR directed graph + SCC feedback handling; feed-forward = trustworthy tier, feedback module = flagged/abstain, no-edge = no context
